items.title: Enable a site, test and reload
items.body:
sudo ln -s /etc/nginx/sites-available/myapp /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/
sudo nginx -t
sudo systemctl reload nginx
items.description: Debian/Ubuntu layout; always test the config first.

items.description: Where to look when something returns 502 or 404.

items.title: systemd service for gunicorn (Django)
items.body:
[Unit]
Description=Gunicorn for myapp
After=network.target

[Service]
User=www-data
Group=www-data
WorkingDirectory=/srv/myapp
EnvironmentFile=/srv/myapp/.env
ExecStart=/srv/myapp/.venv/bin/gunicorn config.wsgi:application --bind 127.0.0.1:8000 --workers 3
Restart=on-failure

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

items.title: systemd service for uvicorn (FastAPI)
items.body:
[Unit]
Description=Uvicorn for myapi
After=network.target

[Service]
User=www-data
WorkingDirectory=/srv/myapi
EnvironmentFile=/srv/myapi/.env
ExecStart=/srv/myapi/.venv/bin/uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 --workers 2
Restart=on-failure

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

items.title: Enable and manage the service
items.body:
sudo systemctl daemon-reload
sudo systemctl enable --now myapp
sudo systemctl status myapp
sudo systemctl restart myapp
journalctl -u myapp -f
items.description: Reload systemd after editing unit files.

items.title: Certbot: HTTPS with Let's Encrypt
items.body:
sudo apt install certbot python3-certbot-nginx
sudo certbot --nginx -d example.com -d www.example.com
items.description: Install the nginx plugin and get a certificate.

items.title: Certbot: test renewal
items.body:
sudo certbot renew --dry-run
sudo certbot certificates
items.description: Certificates renew automatically; verify the process works.

items.title: Open the firewall for web traffic
items.body:
sudo ufw allow OpenSSH
sudo ufw allow 'Nginx Full'
sudo ufw enable
sudo ufw status
items.description: Allow HTTP/HTTPS and SSH with ufw.

items.title: Django deploy steps
items.body:
cd /srv/myapp && git pull
source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -r requirements.txt
python manage.py migrate --noinput
python manage.py collectstatic --noinput
sudo systemctl restart myapp
items.description: Typical update on a single server.

items.title: Deployment checklist
items.body:
[ ] DEBUG is off and SECRET_KEY comes from the environment
[ ] ALLOWED_HOSTS and CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGINS set to the real domain
[ ] HTTPS works and HTTP redirects to it
[ ] Database backups run and a restore was tested
[ ] Static and media files are served correctly
[ ] Service restarts on failure and on reboot
[ ] Logs are visible and rotated
[ ] Firewall allows only SSH, HTTP and HTTPS
[ ] Error reporting or monitoring is configured
[ ] A rollback plan exists (previous release + database migration plan)

items.title: Troubleshoot 502 Bad Gateway
items.body:
sudo systemctl status myapp          # is the app running?
curl -I http://127.0.0.1:8000        # does it answer locally?
sudo tail -n 50 /var/log/nginx/error.log
journalctl -u myapp -n 50 --no-pager
items.description: Nginx cannot reach the app server.
